title: Product intake register — the three links supplied by the operator
column_rule: A cell is blank when no official source states it. Blanks are intentional, not omissions. Format checks are arithmetic on the string the operator supplied and need no external source.

products.asin_format_rule: An ASIN is a combination of 10 letters and numbers.
products.why_blank: The token is 9 characters (an ASIN is 10), and amazon.com/dp/<token> returns a 404 page, so no product detail page could be identified. The page the short link happened to show carries 'lv=shuf' + 'plpRedirect=mhFallback' — a fallback shuffle to a featured item — so its content is not attributable to the operator's link.

products.asin_format_rule: An ASIN is a combination of 10 letters and numbers.
products.why_blank: Same as P-1: 9-character token, 404 on the catalog lookup, and the short-link target is a fallback shuffle page rather than a resolved product page.

They are published here for transparency, NOT adopted as the operator's products, because a fallback shuffle target is not evidence of intent. Verify in the Associates dashboard before using them.
